raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#41602 retired `nightly-8-gpu-mi35x-glm52-fp8` in favour of GLM-5.3. That job's perf step was the only GLM throughput benchmark on MI35x, so the MI35x nightly lost that coverage. The GLM-5.3 cookbook also ships its MI355X FP8 cells as `verified: false` with no AMD benchmark numbers, so nothing measures GLM-5.3 throughput on AMD yet.

## Modifications

- **New test** `test/registered/amd/perf/mi35x/test_glm53_perf_mi35x.py`, suite `nightly-perf-8-gpu-mi35x-glm53`:
  - `NightlyBenchmarkRunner` against `zai-org/GLM-5.3` (FP8), with the cookbook's MI355X / FP8 / low-latency / single-node cell. These are the same server args as the GLM-5.3 accuracy test: `--tp 8 --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang --dsa-decode-backend tilelang --chunked-prefill-size 131072 --mem-fraction-static 0.80 --watchdog-timeout 1200`, plus the `glm45` / `glm47` parsers and multithreaded weight loading.
  - It runs 8K input / 1K output at batch 1, 8, 16 and 64. Batch 1, 16 and 64 are concurrency points on the cookbook's benchmark card, and 8 keeps the range the GLM-5.2-FP8 benchmark covered. The first batch-1 run is a warmup that the report drops.
  - It mirrors `test_glm52_fp8_perf_mi35x.py`, which stays in the tree.
- **New step** `Performance Test MI35x ROCm (8-GPU GLM-5.3 FP8)` in the existing `nightly-8-gpu-mi35x-glm53` job, after the accuracy step:
  - It uses the same layout as the retired GLM-5.2-FP8 job: 120-minute step timeout, 5400 s per-file cap, and `continue-on-error: true`, so a perf problem doesn't fail the job.
  - Running in the same job means accuracy gates perf, the ~700 GB checkpoint is already cached, and it takes no extra 8-GPU MI35x slot.
  - No new job, dropdown option or `check-all-jobs.needs` entry is needed. The section comments now read "MI30x accuracy, MI35x accuracy + performance".
- There is no `run_suite.py` change. AMD suites aren't validated against `NIGHTLY_SUITES`, and the existing `nightly-perf-8-gpu-mi35x-*` suites aren't listed there either.
- **Cleanup:** the GLM-5.3 accuracy steps for MI30x and MI35x get their backslash line continuations back. In #41602 they had collapsed into one long line padded with spaces. There is no functional change.

## Validation

Dispatched `nightly-8-gpu-mi35x-glm53` on this branch with `continue_on_error=false` on rocm10 only ([run 36551834936](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36551834936), [job 109351606539](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36551834936/job/109351606539)). Both steps passed against the warm cache:

- **Accuracy:** GSM8K 0.9757 (threshold 0.92), 1080 s
- **Perf:** the sweep finished in 293 s (300 s wall clock including server launch)

| batch size | input len | latency (s) | input throughput (tok/s) | output throughput (tok/s) | ITL (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 8192 | 12.55 | 14769.58 | 85.35 | 11.72 |
| 8 | 8192 | 21.30 | 14366.18 | 489.57 | 16.34 |
| 16 | 8192 | 28.17 | 15640.60 | 827.72 | 19.33 |
| 64 | 8192 | 61.41 | 15604.54 | 2356.19 | 27.16 |

The perf step adds no new model or image dependency beyond the accuracy step, which #41602 already validated on rocm10, rocm724 and rocm720.

## Checklist

- [x] Perf step passes on MI35x (rocm10)
- [x] Rebased onto `main` after #41602 merged

@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+"""MI35x nightly performance benchmark for GLM-5.3 (FP8, 8-GPU).
+
+Benchmarks zai-org/GLM-5.3 at TP8 with the cookbook's MI355X / FP8 /
+low-latency / single-node server configuration, the same cell the GLM-5.3
+accuracy test launches. The cookbook ships that cell as `verified: false` with
+no AMD benchmark numbers, so this is the first recurring throughput measurement
+of it. At 8K-input / 1K-output, batch 1, 16 and 64 are concurrency points on
+the cookbook's benchmark card, and 8 keeps the batch range the retired
+GLM-5.2-FP8 MI35x benchmark covered.
+
+This runs after the GLM-5.3 accuracy test in the same job. The ~700 GB
+checkpoint is therefore already cached, accuracy gates performance, and the
+two tests consume one scarce 8-GPU MI35x slot rather than two.
+
+Registry: nightly-perf-8-gpu-mi35x-glm53 suite
+"""
+
+import os
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.nightly_bench_utils import generate_simple_markdown_report
+from sglang.test.nightly_utils import NightlyBenchmarkRunner
+from sglang.test.test_utils import DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST, _parse_int_list_env
+
+register_amd_ci(
+    est_time=5400,
+    suite="nightly-perf-8-gpu-mi35x-glm53",
+    nightly=True,
+)
+
+GLM_53_MODEL_PATH = os.environ.get("GLM53_MODEL_PATH", "zai-org/GLM-5.3")
+RESULT_DIR = "performance_results_glm53_mi35x"
+
+
+class TestGLM53PerfMI35x(unittest.TestCase):
+    """GLM-5.3 low-latency throughput on AMD MI35x."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        # The leading 1 is repeated so the report helper drops it as a warmup
+        # run: this step launches its own server, so the first request pays for
+        # warmup and batch 1 is the row that distorts most.
+        cls.batch_sizes = [1, 1, 8, 16, 64]
+        cls.input_lens = tuple(_parse_int_list_env("NIGHTLY_INPUT_LENS", "8192"))
+        cls.output_lens = tuple(_parse_int_list_env("NIGHTLY_OUTPUT_LENS", "1024"))
+        cls.model_config = {
+            "name": "low-latency-tp8",
+            "model_path": GLM_53_MODEL_PATH,
+            "other_args": [
+                "--trust-remote-code",
+                "--reasoning-parser",
+                "glm45",
+                "--tool-call-parser",
+                "glm47",
+                "--tp",
+                "8",
+                "--dsa-prefill-backend",
+                "tilelang",
+                "--dsa-decode-backend",
+                "tilelang",
+                "--chunked-prefill-size",
+                "131072",
+                "--mem-fraction-static",
+                "0.80",
+                "--model-loader-extra-config",
+                '{"enable_multithread_load": true}',
+                "--watchdog-timeout",
+                "1200",
+            ],
+        }
+
+        os.environ.setdefault("SGLANG_BENCH_TIMEOUT", "3600")
+        cls.runner = NightlyBenchmarkRunner(RESULT_DIR, cls.__name__, cls.base_url)
+        cls.runner.setup_result_directory()
+        cls.runner.full_report = f"## {cls.__name__}\n"
+
+    def test_glm53_perf(self):
+        """Run the GLM-5.3 batch-size sweep."""
+        try:
+            result_tuple = self.runner.run_benchmark_for_model(
+                model_path=self.model_config["model_path"],
+                batch_sizes=self.batch_sizes,
+                input_lens=self.input_lens,
+                output_lens=self.output_lens,
+                other_args=self.model_config["other_args"],
+                variant=self.model_config["name"],
+                extra_bench_args=["--trust-remote-code"],
+                timeout=5400,
+            )
+            results, success = result_tuple[0], result_tuple[1]
+
+            if results:
+                self.runner.full_report += (
+                    generate_simple_markdown_report(results, default_gpu_config="MI35x")
+                    + "\n"
+                )
+
+            self.assertTrue(
+                success, f"Benchmark failed for {GLM_53_MODEL_PATH} on MI35x"
+            )
+        finally:
+            self.runner.write_final_report()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
